method: Read-only catalog and pg_stat_statements queries. No Logs Explorer, MCP log query or logs API scans.

chat_unread_counts_isolated.note: EXPLAIN ANALYZE as an authenticated member, 12 channel cursors, warm cache.

interpretation: chat_unread_counts runs in 6-20 ms alone but averages 704 ms in production, and many unrelated statements reach the 8 s timeout (max 6.9-7.9 s). The function plan is not the bottleneck; the database is saturated in bursts.

Realtime's WAL polling is the largest database consumer (23,358 s, max 14.7 s). When it stalls, every client's socket drops at once and each recovery re-read lists and unread counts, adding load during the overload.
Each message insert also ran the analytics fact trigger; chat_record_activity ran every minute per open client.

grants.anon: no privileges on messages, dm_messages, dm_blocks or dms
grants.conclusion: 'permission denied' on dm_messages/dm_blocks means requests reached PostgREST without a user JWT (supabase-js falls back to the publishable key when a session cannot be refreshed). RLS and grants are correct and unchanged.

dm_uniqueness: dms_non_luna_participants_unique_idx is UNIQUE (participants) WHERE NOT is_group AND NOT 'Luna' = ANY(participants). The old client lookup did not filter is_group, so a 2-person group with the same members made maybeSingle fail and fell through to an insert.
